issues.description: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None, producing a malformed URL with the literal 'None' in the path.
issues.detail: When the arch regex misses, the function returns None and the caller f-strings it into '.../latest/None/Packages/...'. No exception, no log, just a broken lockfile. Either raise on miss or skip the URL with a loud error. All three reviewers flagged this as a real correctness defect.

issues.description: nevra[0] conflates filename-first-char with package-name-first-letter for the koji Packages subdirectory.
issues.detail: Koji's canonical path uses the first letter of the package NAME, not the filename. The code uses nevra[0].lower() and assumes they match. Works by accident today but the invariant is unstated and fragile. Parse the package name properly or at minimum assert and document the invariant.

issues.description: URL-rewriter lacks a stated contract and the race with koji-tagger lives only in the commit message.
issues.detail: The precondition (every non-pool URL has a recognized arch and NEVRA-shaped filename) and the consumer precondition (lockfile consumed only after tagging completes) are unstated in code. A future maintainer debugging a 404 will lose hours. Add a module-level docstring naming the race and the input invariants.

issues.description: Hardcoded arch list and koji base URL should be hoisted to module-level constants.
issues.detail: The supported arch set and koji_url_base are load-bearing constants duplicated across functions. Hoist to a single SUPPORTED_ARCHES tuple and KOJI_URL_BASE constant so future koji layout changes are a one-line edit instead of a grep.

issues.description: No unit tests for two pure, trivially testable URL-parsing functions.
issues.detail: use_koji_url_only and extract_arch_from_url are pure and deterministic. A 15-20 line test covering coreos-pool passthrough, fedora x86_64, fedora-secondary ppc64le, and an edge-case filename would have caught the nevra[0] and None-arch defects. Author admits rpms.lock.yaml can't be tested locally, which makes testing the local parts more important, not less.

issues.description: Koji path layout is leaked through inline string concatenation rather than a single helper.
issues.detail: The canonical /latest/{arch}/Packages/{letter}/{nevra} layout is an external contract owned by Fedora koji. Encoding it inline scatters the contract. A small build_koji_url(nevra, arch) helper would localize it and make future layout changes trivial. Also, the function name use_koji_url_only is misleading since it rewrites rather than filters.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is NEEDS-WORK but not a blocker on approach: synthesizing the koji path to work around dnf5 is reasonable. Two real correctness defects dominate: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and propagates the literal 'None' into URLs, and nevra[0] conflates filename-first-char with package-name-first-letter. The race with coreos-koji-tagger is acknowledged only in the commit message and needs to live in the code. Hoist constants, add unit tests for the two pure functions, and tighten the module's stated contract before this code outlives its single caller.
